{{Quote|And so upon his funeral pyre burned the Doom of Ulmarah, and the warrior bands stood as ragged bandits, in zigzag lines of mourning.|An excerpt from the ninth chapter of ''Dha Werda Verda''|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
The '''Doom of Ulmarah''' was a [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[General/Legends|general]] who fought and [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Zhell–Taung war|war]] against the [[Battalions of Zhell]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Notron]]. His life and death were recorded within the [[Poet/Legends|poem]] ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]'', and he was remembered long after his demise.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The mere names of the generals awaken something within us: What schoolchild hasn't felt his heart race at the mention of Rexutu the Unconquerable or Olhak the Reaver, or mourned the inevitable downfall of the mighty and noble Doom of Ulmarah?|Hu Jiwbe, ''Imperial Center Today''|<ref name="AC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref>}}
[[File:Last_Stand_of_the_Taungs.jpg|thumb|right|300px|alt=Spear wielding Taungs stand high on a castle battlement as an army of Zhell gather outside the walls.|The Doom of Ulmarah perished shortly before the Taung defeated the Zhell.]]
The [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] known as the Doom of Ulmarah<ref name="EGTW" /> served as a [[General/Legends|general]] amongst the warriors of<ref name="AC" /> his<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] during their [[Zhell–Taung war|war]] against the [[Battalions of Zhell]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Notron]].<ref name="AC" /> He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the war, and his body was [[Cremation/Legends|burned]] on a [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] [[Fire/Legends|pyre]] as groups of Taung warriors mourned. This left the Taung unprotected, but under the leadership of another general known as [[Rexutu the Unconquerable]], they managed to [[Destruction of Zhell|defeat]] the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after the funeral due to a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] eruption destroying the Zhell [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Great Zhell]]. The Doom of Ulmarah's actions and untimely demise, along with the stories of others like Rexutu<ref name="EGTW" /> and [[Olhak the Reaver]],<ref name="AC" /> were immortalized in the Taung epic [[Poet/Legends|poem]] ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]'', with the general's funeral recorded in the ninth chapter<ref name="EGTW" /> within the section known as "The Maker comes to Unmake."<ref name="AC" />

Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the general's death, his part in the Zhell-Taung War was still remembered, with the ''Dha Werda Verda'' verses including his funeral taught to every [[Youngling/Legends|schoolchild]] on Notron, by then known as Coruscant or Imperial Center. The military [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Hu Jibwe]] considered the Doom of Ulmarah noble and mighty, mourning what he considered the warrior's inevitable downfall and mentioning him in an article in the publication ''[[Imperial Center Today]]'' in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Doom of Ulmarah was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a reference book released in [[2012]] and written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> A section of the book that included the general but had ultimately been cut was then published in [[2013]] in [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]] on the [[Star Wars Blog|''Star Wars'' Blog]].<ref name="AC" />
